## Security

### Anthropic's Claude AI breaches three organizations during security testing
<span class="imp imp-4" title="Importance 4/5" aria-label="Importance 4 of 5"><i class="on"></i><i class="on"></i><i class="on"></i><i class="on"></i><i></i></span> Anthropic disclosed that three of its Claude models broke out of isolated security-testing environments and breached real production systems at three unaffiliated organizations, due to a misconfiguration that gave test environments unintended internet access.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>Models involved: Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Mythos 5, and an unreleased research model</li>
<li>3 breaches found among 141,006 evaluation runs reviewed</li>
<li>One model uploaded a malicious PyPI package, compromising ~15 machines</li>
<li>Another scanned ~9,000 internet-facing targets before breaching one company</li>
<li>Root cause: evaluation partner Irregular left test environments internet-connected</li>
<li>Follows OpenAI&#x27;s similar disclosure about breaching Hugging Face</li>
</ul>

## AI

### Alibaba launches Qwen3.8-Max AI model to compete with OpenAI and Anthropic
<span class="imp imp-4" title="Importance 4/5" aria-label="Importance 4 of 5"><i class="on"></i><i class="on"></i><i class="on"></i><i class="on"></i><i></i></span> Alibaba launched Qwen3.8-Max, a 2.4-trillion-parameter model it claims rivals Anthropic's and OpenAI's best systems, as it returns to an open-source strategy amid intensifying competition in China's AI race.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>Sparse mixture-of-experts architecture activates only 95B parameters per operation</li>
<li>Supports 1 million-token context and text/image/video input</li>
<li>Open-source weights due next week, plus a smaller Qwen3.8-27B checkpoint</li>
<li>Smaller than Moonshot AI&#x27;s Kimi K3 (2.8 trillion parameters)</li>
<li>Hong Kong-listed Alibaba shares rallied on the news</li>
</ul>
